note: The graphviz project's own Ubuntu 24.04 build, from its 16.1.0 release on GitLab. The project publishes `.sha256` files for its source tarballs and Windows/macOS builds but not for the Linux packages, so this digest was computed over the downloaded `.deb` (7,804,818 bytes) on 2026-10-07. Unpacked with `dpkg-deb -x`, `usr/bin/dot` finds its own libraries through a relative RPATH and runs from any directory; it still needs the host's libc, libm, libltdl, libz and libexpat, which Ubuntu 24.04 has.
